Without, the night was cold and wet, but in the small parlour of Laburnam Villa the blinds were drawn and the fire burned brightly.

The paw came out of a soldier's pocket wrapped in a scrap of cloth, and it was not a story until it moved.

"Wish for something sensible," the soldier said, and he said it in the voice of a man who had already wished.
